android.notes: v2.3.1（两端同版本）：本版为 Windows 端定向修复，安卓端无功能变化，仅随版本对齐发布；配对与设置原样保留，可直接覆盖升级。 / EN: A Windows-focused fix release; the Android app is functionally unchanged and is bumped only to keep both ends on the same version. Pairings and settings carry over; update in place as usual.

windows.notes: v2.3.1（两端同版本）：根因是驱动安装最后一步依赖 WDK 的 devcon.exe 创建设备节点，普通电脑没有 WDK，驱动包只被暂存、设备从未创建；本版安装包自带基于 Setup API 的 devnode 工具，一键安装可端到端建出设备，不再需要 WDK/devcon。如实说明：新安装链已过全部离线检查，第一次真机安装即是验证步；若装后仍无虚拟设备，连接页会明确提示并可打开驱动文件夹手动重跑一键安装。最小化图标原为零高度线条、实际渲染为零像素，现已改为实心字形，三颗窗口按钮正常态一并提亮。无虚拟设备时明示手机麦克风正送到真实扬声器、其他软件用不了，并可一键打开驱动文件夹；由 VB-CABLE 等第三方线缆兜底时，提示在目标软件麦克风列表选 CABLE Output 才能听到手机声音。安装器与 App 文案改为实际出货设备名：声桥 AirBridge 虚拟音频设备（端点 AirBridge Wave Speaker / AirBridge Wave Microphone）。注：驱动仍为测试签名版，虚拟设备仍需测试模式；虚拟摄像头仍在准备中，不在本版范围。 / EN: Fixed: the virtual audio device never appeared after install — the final step needed the WDK's devcon.exe to create the device node, which normal PCs lack, so the package was only staged. The installer now bundles its own Setup API tool (devnode.exe); the one-click install creates the device end to end, no WDK needed. Honest note: the new chain passed every off-device check, and its first real-machine install is the verification step; if the devices still do not appear, the connect page says so and can open the driver folder for a manual re-run. Fixed: title-bar window buttons invisible until hover (the minimize glyph rendered as zero pixels; now a filled glyph, all three buttons brighter). New: connect-page virtual-device guidance — warns when mic audio is going to the real speakers with a shortcut to the driver folder, and when a third-party cable such as VB-CABLE is standing in, tells you to select CABLE Output as the microphone in the other app. Copy now matches the shipped device names （声桥 AirBridge 虚拟音频设备； endpoints AirBridge Wave Speaker / AirBridge Wave Microphone). The driver is still test-signed (test mode still required); the virtual camera is still in preparation.
